pillars.title: Plating on ABS and ABS/PC Substrates
pillars.desc: Rack plating on the automatic line, {{auto:k}} thousand pieces per day: trivalent and hexavalent nickel-chrome, satin nickel and black nickel-chrome; hairline finish can be made on the nickel-chrome layer.
pillars.imageAlt: ABS plastic grille trim part after nickel-chrome plating

pillars.title: Plating on Metal Substrates
pillars.desc: Electrolytic nickel (bright, durable), electroless nickel (high hardness, wear and heat resistance), black nickel, nickel-chrome and satin plating on iron, copper, steel and aluminum.
pillars.imageAlt: Metal part after electroless nickel plating

pillars.title: Automatic Painting, PVD Vacuum Coating, Printing and Laser
pillars.desc: 3 six-gun spray booths, 1 automatic spray painting line, 20 ionizer booths; 2 PVD machines.
pillars.imageAlt: Automatic spray painting line on a conveyor
